member.name: T:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo
member.summary: Represents detailed information retrieved from a card, such as raw data, tags, and various configuration details.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.RawData
member.summary: Gets or sets the raw binary data associated with the card.
member.remarks: The RawData property represents the unprocessed byte array containing all the data extracted from the card. This data forms the base for parsing and extracting specific details, such as tags, OIDs, and configuration settings.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.Tags
member.summary: Represents a collection of tags and their associated data extracted from the card.
member.remarks: Each tag is identified by a unique 16-bit identifier (ushort) and is associated with a corresponding byte array containing the tag's data. This property is populated during the parsing of card-related data.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.GlobalPlatformVersion
member.summary: Represents the GlobalPlatform version of the card. The GlobalPlatform version is extracted from the card data during parsing and indicates the supported GlobalPlatform specification. This property is read-only and may be null if the version information is not available in the provided data.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.SecureChannelProtocolInfo
member.summary: Gets the secure channel protocol information extracted from the card data. This property represents a portion of the card's tag data that contains information about the secure communication protocol supported by the card. The value is extracted from the card data and corresponds to the tag associated with secure channel protocol information, if available.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.CardConfigurationDetails
member.summary: Represents the card configuration details as a byte array, which may include information such as available features or settings on the card. This property is populated during the parsing of the raw card data.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.CardChipDetails
member.summary: Represents the details associated with the card chip as retrieved from the parsed data tags.
member.remarks: This property is populated from the data tag with identifier 0x66 during the parsing process. It may contain chip-specific information in a byte array format, or be null if the tag is not found in the input data.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.Oids
member.summary: Represents a collection of Object Identifiers (OIDs) extracted from card data information.
member.remarks: - The OIDs provide identifiers that can be used for identifying protocols, features, or specific data structures. - This property contains a list of OIDs parsed from raw card data using predefined parsing logic.
member.value: A list of strings where each string represents an extracted OID in the standard dot-separated notation.

member.name: P:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.GlobalPlatformVersionFromOid
member.summary: Gets the GlobalPlatform version extracted from the corresponding OID (Object Identifier) found during the parsing of card data. This property represents the version information for GlobalPlatform formatted as a string, typically derived from a specific OID pattern in the data.
member.remarks: If no valid GlobalPlatform version OID is found during parsing, this property will return null.

members.member: Parses the given byte array to extract card information and populate a CardDataInfo object. The byte array containing card data to be parsed. Result containing a CardDataInfo object populated with the extracted card information.

Parses the GlobalPlatform version from the provided byte array. GlobalPlatform versions are typically encoded in BCD (Binary Coded Decimal) format. The byte array containing the GlobalPlatform version information.
A object representing the parsed GlobalPlatform version, or null if the data length is insufficient to determine a valid version.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.BcdToByte(System.Byte)
member.summary: Converts a BCD (Binary Coded Decimal) byte to its decimal equivalent.
member.returns: The decimal equivalent.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.CardInfo.CardDataInfo.ToString
member.summary: Converts the current state of the CardDataInfo instance, including parsed OIDs, GlobalPlatform version, secure channel protocol information, card configuration details, card chip details, and all tag data, into a readable string format.
member.returns: A string representation of the CardDataInfo instance, providing detailed information about its parsed contents and metadata.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Keys.KeyDerivationService.DeriveScp03SessionKeys(Gp4Net.Cryptography.IKeyDerivationContext)
member.summary: Derives SCP03 session keys using SP 800-108 KDF in counter mode. Per GlobalPlatform SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 4.1.5 "Data Derivation Scheme" and Section 6.2.1 "Session Keys". Uses NIST SP 800-108 KDF in counter mode with AES-CMAC as the PRF.

member.summary: Derives a single SCP03 key using SP 800-108 KDF. Per GlobalPlatform SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 4.1.5 "Data Derivation Scheme". Uses the exact GP structure: Counter(1) + Label(12) + Separator(1) + L(2) + Context(16) PRF is CMAC as specified in NIST SP 800-38B with full 16 byte output.

member.summary: Derives data using SCP03 key derivation scheme for non-key derivation purposes. Per GlobalPlatform SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 4.1.5 "Data Derivation Scheme". Used for cryptogram generation, card challenge generation, etc.
member.param: The key to use for derivation (KDK).
The desired output length in bits.
member.returns: The derived data or an error.

member.summary: Derives SCP02 session keys. Per GlobalPlatform Card Specification v2.3.1 Section E.4.1 "SCP02 - Session Key Derivation". Uses 3DES ECB encryption of derivation data.

member.summary: Derives a single SCP02 key using 3DES-CBC encryption. Per GlobalPlatform Card Specification v2.3.1 Section E.4.1: "Session keys are the result of encrypting derivation data with the static keys" Per Figure E-2: Derivation data format (16 bytes): constant (2 bytes) || sequence counter (2 bytes) || padding (12 bytes)

member.name: T:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService
member.summary: Service for calculating cryptographic authentication values (cryptograms) according to GlobalPlatform specifications. Implements proper cryptogram calculation for SCP02 and SCP03 protocols. Per GP SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 6.2.2: SCP03 cryptograms use data derivation scheme (KDF). Per GP Card Spec v2.3.1 Section E.4.2: SCP02 cryptograms use Full 3DES MAC.

member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
member.param: Optional key derivation service. If null, creates a new instance.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateCardCryptogram(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Byte[],CSharpFunctionalExtensions.Maybe{System.Byte[]},Gp4Net.Constants.ScpVersion)
member.summary: Calculates a card cryptogram for the specified protocol. Per GP SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 6.2.2.2: SCP03 uses data derivation scheme with S-MAC key. Per GP Card Spec v2.3.1 Section E.4.2.1: SCP02 uses Full 3DES MAC with S-ENC key.
member.param: The MAC key to use for cryptogram calculation.
member.returns: The calculated card cryptogram (8 bytes) or an error.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateHostCryptogram(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Byte[],CSharpFunctionalExtensions.Maybe{System.Byte[]},Gp4Net.Constants.ScpVersion)
member.summary: Calculates a host cryptogram for the specified protocol. Per GP SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 6.2.2.3: SCP03 uses data derivation scheme with S-MAC key. Per GP Card Spec v2.3.1 Section E.4.2.2: SCP02 uses Full 3DES MAC with S-ENC key.
member.param: The MAC key to use for cryptogram calculation.
member.returns: The calculated host cryptogram (8 bytes) or an error.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateCryptogram(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],Gp4Net.Constants.ScpVersion)
member.summary: Calculates a generic cryptogram using the specified protocol and data. This is a lower-level method for custom cryptogram calculations. NOTE: For SCP03 authentication cryptograms, use CalculateCardCryptogram/CalculateHostCryptogram instead, as they properly use the data derivation scheme per GP SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 6.2.2.
member.param: The key to use for cryptogram calculation.
member.returns: The calculated cryptogram or an error.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateScp02CardCryptogram(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Byte[],CSharpFunctionalExtensions.Maybe{System.Byte[]})
member.summary: Calculates SCP02 card cryptogram using 3DES-CBC-MAC. Per GlobalPlatform Card Specification v2.3.1 Section E.4.2.1. Data format: Host Challenge (8) || Sequence Counter (2) || Card Challenge (6) || Padding.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateScp02HostCryptogram(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Byte[],CSharpFunctionalExtensions.Maybe{System.Byte[]})
member.summary: Calculates SCP02 host cryptogram using 3DES-CBC-MAC. Per GlobalPlatform Card Specification v2.3.1 Section E.4.2.2. Data format: Sequence Counter (2) || Card Challenge (6) || Host Challenge (8) || Padding.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateScp03CardCryptogram(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Calculates SCP03 card cryptogram using data derivation scheme. Per GlobalPlatform SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 6.2.2.2: "The card cryptogram (8 bytes) is calculated using the data derivation scheme defined in section 4.1.5 with the session key S-MAC and the derivation constant set to 'card authentication cryptogram generation'." Derivation constant: 0x00, Context: Host Challenge (8) || Card Challenge (8), Length: 0x0040 (64 bits).

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateScp03HostCryptogram(System.Byte[],System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Calculates SCP03 host cryptogram using data derivation scheme. Per GlobalPlatform SCP03 v1.1.1 Section 6.2.2.3: "The host cryptogram (8 bytes) is calculated using the data derivation scheme defined in section 4.1.5 with the session key S-MAC and the derivation constant set to 'host authentication cryptogram generation'." Derivation constant: 0x01, Context: Host Challenge (8) || Card Challenge (8), Length: 0x0040 (64 bits).

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.CalculateAesCmac(System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Calculates AES-CMAC using BouncyCastle.

member.name: M:Gp4Net.Domain.Security.CryptogramService.Calculate3DesCbcMac(System.Byte[],System.Byte[])
member.summary: Calculates Full 3DES MAC for SCP02 cryptograms. Per GlobalPlatform Card Specification v2.3.1 Section B.1.2.1 "Full Triple DES": "The result of the last encryption with the Triple DES key is the MAC." Used specifically for SCP02 cryptograms as specified in Section E.4.2.
